extensions.description: Schedule a helper's checks and read its progress. Optional: without it a task checks every 15m for 24h.

description: Standing helpers. Each task is one helper with its own memory that checks something on a schedule and reports only what changed. Tasks run for hours or days: send with returnImmediately and a push notification config, or stream.
name: contactd helpers

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: The token in a2a.token in the server's data directory.

skills.description: Check a web page or endpoint on a schedule and report meaningful changes. Stays silent when nothing changed. Asks with TASK_STATE_INPUT_REQUIRED when the brief is ambiguous.
examples: Check https://example.com/status every 5 minutes for the next 2 hours and tell me when it stops saying operational.
skills.name: Watch and report
